summary: 5 V power tolerance and supervisor hysteresis do not guarantee release or valid ADC operation.
description: U25 R-78E5.0-1.0 permits 4.75 V static (5 V minus 5%) before ripple; U18 TPS3808G01 with R7/R8 nominally trips at 4.8195 V. Including +/-2% VIT, 3% max hysteresis, 0.1% resistors and +/-25 nA sense current yields falling threshold 4.711744..4.927632 V and worst release 5.075379 V. Thus a compliant regulator may never release reset, and low supervisor corners permit operation below the ADC 4.75 V minimum. No single resistor change fixes both limits.
recommendation: Redesign the 5A regulator/supervisor tolerance budget together; release gate must remain blocked until minimum rail exceeds maximum release while minimum trip exceeds ADC minimum. TPS3808E retains broad accuracy/hysteresis and is not a complete fix.

summary: The +/-12 V monitor thresholds depend on the 3.3 V rail; nominal thresholds are not fixed guarantees.
description: U19 compares divided rails to REF_MON=V33/2. At V33=3.300 V resistor0.1%, LM393B offset+/-4mV and input bias0..50nA give +12 trip10.35575..10.46791 V and -12 trip-10.51493..-10.31878 V. TPS3828-33 can wait until2.86 V before asserting; at V33=2.86 V these become +8.97127..9.07598 V and -9.12405..-8.93797 V. The design has no fixed independent reference, no specified Seed3 3V3 tolerance or explicit comparator hysteresis.
recommendation: State the ratios and rail bounds accurately; qualify brownout ramps and add a stable reference/tighter monitor if a fixed ~10.4 V threshold is required.

summary: Generic 0.5 W jack resistors lack continuous margin for an amplifier rail fault against an opposite external rail.
description: Normal +/-5 V command versus opposite +/-12 V gives at most0.29192 W with Rmin990ohm, so0.5W is plausible for normal collisions. An internal output saturation at11.5 V against opposite12 V produces0.55783 W; a conservative24 V differential produces0.58182 W. No exact resistor MPN or local thermal qualification exists in the original source.
recommendation: Specify Vishay CRCW20101K00FKEFHP, 2010 1k 1% HP, conservative P70=1W; preserve thermal qualification and155C film limit. Apply consistently to RI1..8 and RO1..8 with unchanged footprint and resistance.

summary: Use a Schmitt-input fault latch for the shared open-drain reset bus.
description: U16 SN74HC74 has a maximum input-transition requirement; SAFE_CLEAR_N rises through10k with four switch flags, two supervisors, comparator outputs and MCU input. Bus capacitance/rise time has not been qualified. Pin-compatible SN74HCS74DR explicitly supports slow/noisy signals and retains pinout/function.
recommendation: Replace U16 with SN74HCS74DR, update schematic/BOM/export values and docs. No routing or package change required. Firmware must still honor reset release and recovery before permit edge.
